content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an inaccurate approximation of `io_ticks` for slow disks, where only the first and last jiffies were accounted for requests that took longer than two jiffies. This led to an underestimation of the I/O time for such requests, particularly when the disk was executing one request at a time. The fix involved modifying the `update_io_ticks` function to add the actual number of jiffies that passed since the last update, rather than just incrementing by one, thus providing a more accurate measurement of I/O time.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: +void update_io_ticks(struct hd_struct *part, unsigned long now, bool end);
